"""Build and compare independent lab3 variants on Linux ARM; never installs over a course project."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, os, platform, re, statistics, subprocess, tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
VARIANTS = {'baseline': 'graphic-baseline.c', 'serial': 'graphic-serial.c', 'parallel': 'graphic.c',
            'fast-scalar':'graphic-fast.c','fast-neon':'graphic-fast.c','fast-parallel':'graphic-fast.c',
            'batch':'graphic-batch.c','batch-parallel':'graphic-batch.c'}

def parse_metrics(output):
    patterns = {'pixel': r'draw pixel:\s*(\d+) ms', 'rect': r'draw rect:\s*(\d+) ms',
                'line': r'draw line:\s*(\d+) ms', 'jpg': r'\*\*jpeg:\s*(\d+)',
                'png': r'\*\*png:\s*(\d+)', 'font': r'\*\*font:\s*(\d+)',
                'text': r'draw text:\s*(\d+) ms', 'total': r'Total time:\s*(\d+) ms'}
    values = {}
    for name, pattern in patterns.items():
        matches = re.findall(pattern, output)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Missing or duplicate timing: ' + name)
        values[name] = int(matches[0])
    if values['total'] != sum(values[k] for k in values if k != 'total'):
        raise ValueError('Total differs from seven stage timings')
    return values

def snapshot():
    values = {}
    for pattern in ('/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/scaling_*',
                    '/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp', '/proc/loadavg'):
        import glob
        for name in glob.glob(pattern):
            try:
                if Path(name).is_file(): values[name] = Path(name).read_text().strip()
            except (OSError, UnicodeError): pass
    return values

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--project', required=True, help='Existing course project, used only for external libraries')
    parser.add_argument('--build-only', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--runs', type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument('--threads', type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument('--threshold', type=int, default=65536)
    parser.add_argument('--variants',default='baseline,fast-neon,fast-parallel',help='Comma-separated variant names')
    parser.add_argument('--lto',action='store_true',help='Apply link-time optimization to every selected variant')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    names=args.variants.split(',')
    if not names or len(set(names))!=len(names) or any(v not in VARIANTS for v in names):
        parser.error('Unknown or duplicate variant. Choose: '+','.join(VARIANTS))
    if args.runs < 1 or args.runs > 20 or args.threads < 1 or args.threads > 64 or args.threshold < 1:
        parser.error('Invalid runs, threads or threshold')
    if os.name != 'posix': parser.error('Run on the Linux board; this is not a Windows build')
    if any(v.startswith(('fast','batch')) for v in names) and platform.machine().lower() not in ('aarch64','arm64'):
        parser.error('Fast native validation requires the AArch64 board; host simulation is separate')
    project = Path(args.project).resolve(strict=True)
    external = project / 'common/external'
    if not (external / 'include').is_dir() or not (external / 'lib').is_dir():
        parser.error('Missing course common/external/include or lib')
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / 'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for name, expected in manifest['sourceHashes'].items():
        if hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise RuntimeError('Package file changed: ' + name)
    record = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='board-comparison-', dir=str(ROOT)))
    print('Records:', record, flush=True)
    compiler = subprocess.run(['gcc','--version'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    (record/'compiler.txt').write_text(compiler)
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = str(external/'lib') + os.pathsep + environment.get('LD_LIBRARY_PATH','')
    environment['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = str(args.threads)
    environment['OMP_DYNAMIC'] = 'FALSE'
    # Do not inherit hidden settings that alter team size, nesting or placement.
    environment['OMP_THREAD_LIMIT'] = str(args.threads)
    environment['OMP_MAX_ACTIVE_LEVELS'] = '1'
    results = {'recordedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               'threads':args.threads, 'threshold':args.threshold, 'compiler':compiler,
               'packageManifest':manifest, 'runs':[], 'commands':{},
               'courseTimingExcludesFlush':True, 'flushTimingsRecordedSeparately':True}
    if any(v.startswith(('fast','batch')) for v in names):
        from native_checks import native_checks
        results['nativeChecksPassed']=native_checks(project,record,environment)
    if any(v.startswith('batch') for v in names):
        from native_checks import native_batch_checks
        results['nativeBatchChecksPassed']=native_batch_checks(project,record,environment)
        print('EXPERIMENT: batch variants change the JPEG drawing API; all execution stays inside its timer.',flush=True)
    for variant in names:
        graphic=VARIANTS[variant]
        directory = record/variant
        out = directory/'out'
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in ('test.jpg','test.png','font.ttc'):
            (out/name).symlink_to(ROOT/'out'/name)
        flags = ['-Wall','-O3']
        if variant in ('parallel','fast-parallel','batch-parallel'): flags += ['-fopenmp','-DFB_PARALLEL_MIN_PIXELS='+str(args.threshold)]
        if variant=='fast-scalar':flags+=['-DFB_DISABLE_NEON']
        if args.lto:flags+=['-flto']
        graphics_unit = directory/'graphics-build.c'
        graphics_unit.write_text('#define fb_update fb_update_impl\n#include '+json.dumps(str(ROOT/'common'/graphic))+'\n')
        command = ['gcc',*flags,'-I'+str(ROOT/'common'),'-I'+str(external/'include'),
                   str(graphics_unit),
                   str(ROOT/'common'/('image-fast.c' if variant.startswith(('fast','batch')) else 'image.c')), str(ROOT/'common/task.c'),
                   str(ROOT/'test'/('batch-main.c' if variant.startswith('batch') else 'main.c')), str(ROOT/'flush_probe.c'),
                   '-L'+str(external/'lib'), '-ljpeg','-lfreetype','-lpng','-lasound','-lz','-lm',
                   '-o',str(out/'test')]
        results['commands'][variant] = command
        compiled = subprocess.run(command, env=environment, capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
        (directory/'build.log').write_text(compiled.stdout+compiled.stderr)
        if compiled.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('Build failed: '+str(directory/'build.log'))
        if not args.build_only:
            subprocess.run(['python3',str(ROOT/'preflight.py'),'--project',str(directory),'--lab','test'],check=True)
    if not args.build_only:
        for iteration in range(args.runs):
            # Rotate order to reduce always giving one variant the cold run.
            for variant in names[iteration%len(names):] + names[:iteration%len(names)]:
                out = record/variant/'out'
                before = snapshot()
                run = subprocess.run([str(out/'test')],cwd=out,env=environment,
                                     capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
                logfile = record/variant/('run-%02d.log'%(iteration+1))
                logfile.write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
                if run.returncode: raise RuntimeError('Test failed: '+str(logfile))
                metrics = parse_metrics(run.stdout)
                flush = [float(v) for v in re.findall(r'FLUSH_US=(\d+)',run.stderr)]
                if not flush: raise RuntimeError('Missing flush timing: '+str(logfile))
                results['runs'].append({'variant':variant,'iteration':iteration+1,'timingsMs':metrics,
                    'explicitBatchApiExperiment':variant.startswith('batch'),
                    'batchWorkload':{k:int(v) for k,v in re.findall(r'(submitted_pixels|copied_pixels|row_checks|interval_comparisons|flushes)=(\d+)',run.stdout)},
                    'flushUs':flush,'before':before,'after':snapshot(),'log':str(logfile)})
                print(variant,metrics,flush=True)
                (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
        results['medianMs'] = {v:{k:statistics.median(r['timingsMs'][k] for r in results['runs'] if r['variant']==v)
                                  for k in results['runs'][0]['timingsMs']} for v in names}
        print(json.dumps(results['medianMs'],indent=2))
    (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    print('Done:', record)

if __name__ == '__main__': main()

"""Board-only memory-buffer checks; uses real ARM intrinsics and real FreeType."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def native_checks(project,record,environment):
    check=record/'native-checks';check.mkdir()
    source=(ROOT/'common/graphic-fast.c').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    globals_=source[source.index('static int LCD_FB_FD;'):source.index('void fb_init(')]
    globals_=globals_.replace('static int LCD_FB_FD;\n','').replace('static int DRAW_BUF[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];',
      'static struct {int before[GUARD_WORDS];int pixels[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];int after[GUARD_WORDS];} TEST_BACK;\n#define DRAW_BUF TEST_BACK.pixels')
    (check/'graphics-under-test.c').write_text('#include "common.h"\n#include <limits.h>\n#include <math.h>\n#define GUARD_WORDS 64\n'+globals_+source[source.index('static void _copy_area('):])
    common=['gcc','-O3','-Wall','-Wextra','-fopenmp','-DFB_PARALLEL_MIN_PIXELS=1','-I'+str(check),'-I'+str(ROOT/'common'),
            '-I'+str(ROOT/'tests'),'-I'+str(project/'common/external/include')]
    passed=[]
    for name in ('test_fast_rows','test_lab2_regression','test_images','test_text_real'):
        exe=check/name
        sources=[str(ROOT/'tests'/(name+'.c'))]
        if name!='test_fast_rows':sources += [str(ROOT/'common/image-fast.c')]
        command=common+sources+['-L'+str(project/'common/external/lib'),'-ljpeg','-lpng','-lfreetype','-lz','-lm','-o',str(exe)]
        built=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=environment,timeout=180)
        (check/(name+'-build.log')).write_text(built.stdout+built.stderr)
        if built.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Native validation build failed: '+str(check/(name+'-build.log')))
        args=[str(exe)]+([str(ROOT/'out/font.ttc')] if name=='test_text_real' else [])
        for threads in ((1,2,4) if name in ('test_images','test_text_real') else (1,)):
            env=dict(environment);env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']=str(threads);env['OMP_THREAD_LIMIT']=str(threads)
            run=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=180)
            log=check/(name+'-'+str(threads)+'.log');log.write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
            print(run.stdout,flush=True)
            if run.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Native pixel validation failed: '+str(log))
            passed.append(name+'-'+str(threads))
    return passed

def native_batch_checks(project,record,environment):
    check=record/'native-batch-checks';check.mkdir()
    source=(ROOT/'common/graphic-batch.c').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    globals_=source[source.index('static int LCD_FB_FD;'):source.index('void fb_init(')]
    globals_=globals_.replace('static int LCD_FB_FD;\n','').replace('static int DRAW_BUF[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];',
      'static struct {int before[GUARD_WORDS];int pixels[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];int after[GUARD_WORDS];} TEST_BACK;\n#define DRAW_BUF TEST_BACK.pixels')
    (check/'graphics-under-test.c').write_text('#include "common.h"\n#include <limits.h>\n#include <math.h>\n#define GUARD_WORDS 64\n'+globals_+source[source.index('static void _copy_area('):])
    passed=[]
    for capacity in (256,3):
        exe=check/('check-'+str(capacity))
        command=['gcc','-O3','-Wall','-Wextra','-fopenmp','-DFB_BATCH_CAPACITY='+str(capacity),
                 '-I'+str(check),'-I'+str(ROOT/'common'),'-I'+str(ROOT/'tests'),'-I'+str(project/'common/external/include'),
                 str(ROOT/'tests/test_opaque_batch.c'),str(ROOT/'common/image-fast.c'),
                 '-L'+str(project/'common/external/lib'),'-ljpeg','-lpng','-lfreetype','-lz','-lm','-o',str(exe)]
        build=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=environment,timeout=180)
        (check/('build-'+str(capacity)+'.log')).write_text(build.stdout+build.stderr)
        if build.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Native batch build failed: '+str(check))
        for threads in (1,2,4):
            env=dict(environment);env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']=str(threads);env['OMP_THREAD_LIMIT']=str(threads)
            run=subprocess.run([str(exe),str(ROOT/'out/test.jpg')],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=180)
            log=check/('capacity-%d-threads-%d.log'%(capacity,threads));log.write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
            print(run.stdout,flush=True)
            if run.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Native batch pixels differ: '+str(log))
            passed.append(log.name)
    # Diagnostic replay uses real assets/FreeType but fake time and no sleeps.
    # It is a pixel-equivalence gate, never a performance result.
    import re
    stage_hashes={}
    for name in ('test_original_replay','test_batch_replay'):
        exe=check/name
        command=['gcc','-O3','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wno-unused-parameter','-fopenmp',
                 '-I'+str(check),'-I'+str(ROOT/'common'),'-I'+str(ROOT/'tests'),'-I'+str(project/'common/external/include'),
                 str(ROOT/'tests'/(name+'.c')),str(ROOT/'common/image-fast.c'),
                 '-L'+str(project/'common/external/lib'),'-ljpeg','-lpng','-lfreetype','-lz','-lm','-o',str(exe)]
        build=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=environment,timeout=180)
        (check/(name+'-build.log')).write_text(build.stdout+build.stderr)
        if build.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Native full-replay build failed: '+str(check))
        for threads in (1,4):
            env=dict(environment);env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']=str(threads);env['OMP_THREAD_LIMIT']=str(threads)
            run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],cwd=ROOT/'out',capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=180)
            log=check/(name+'-'+str(threads)+'.log');log.write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
            hashes=re.findall(r'STAGE_HASH (\d+) ([0-9a-f]+)',run.stdout)
            if run.returncode or len(hashes)!=9:raise RuntimeError('Native full-replay failed: '+str(log))
            stage_hashes[(name,threads)]=hashes;passed.append(log.name)
    if not all(v==stage_hashes[('test_original_replay',1)] for v in stage_hashes.values()):
        raise RuntimeError('Native full-replay stage hashes differ: '+str(check))
    print('PASS: real-asset full-replay stage hashes match; diagnostic time values are invalid.',flush=True)
    return passed
